factual_claims.claim: SituationalLLM outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs (GPT-4, LLaMA-3) in providing precise, task-specific, and contextually relevant instructions.
The SAD-Instruct dataset contains 95.2 million tokens in total.
The SAD dataset is derived from 3DSSG, which provides 3D semantic scene graphs for 1,482 RGB-D scans in the 3RScan dataset.
Fine-tuning SituationalLLM for 10 epochs on 76.9M tokens takes approximately 48 hours on one H100 80GB GPU.
The SAD dataset contains 163.8k scans and 88.9 scenarios.
The SAD dataset is split into 80% training and 20% testing.
SituationalLLM uses LoRA with a rank of r = 64, a scaling factor of Î± = 32, and a dropout rate of 0.05.
The project received funding from the European Unionâ€™s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under grant agreement No. 101135724.
The SAD dataset includes up to 534 distinct object classes and 93 unique attributes.
